## Implemented Behavior

- Draft sessions show `Publish` and `Archive`.
- Published sessions show `Unpublish` and `Archive`.
- Archived sessions show `Restore`.
- `Draft` remains a status label; `Unpublish` is the action label for the published-to-draft transition.
- Selecting an action submits immediately.
- Archive keeps the existing confirmation prompt.
- Successful mutations return to `/admin/classroom` and refresh the session list.
- The existing admin middleware and server-side lifecycle endpoints remain in force.
